name: pinboard
description: Session pinboard: open questions Claude asked stay above the prompt; a pane keeps branch, PRs, links, pinned docs and a memo beside the chat.

jiraBase.title: Jira site
jiraBase.description: Your Jira site, e.g. https://your-team.atlassian.net. Issue keys the session mentions link to it. Empty: no Jira row.

jiraProjects.title: Jira project keys
jiraProjects.description: Comma-separated project keys to pick up, e.g. WEB,APP. Any other KEY-123 (GPT-4, CVE-2024) is ignored. Empty: no Jira row.

commands.title: Toolbar commands
commands.description: Comma-separated slash commands (without /) the pane's toolbar fills into the prompt, e.g. review,commit. Empty: no buttons.
